scope: Local audio upload and format verification
pipeline: Local API and isolated PostgreSQL database
Authenticated artist fixture with normal sponsorship activation
Real Mux processing by local worker
HLS playlists and segments fetched and decoded with FFmpeg

browser.environment: Local component harness mounting the production ReleaseTracklistEditor and ReleaseAudioUploader with a fixture session; real API and providers
browser.result: All three persisted in the release and displayed Audio ready after reload
browser.invalidFile: PNG bytes renamed not-audio.mp3 rejected by API; error visible; temporary track/session cleaned up

limitations: Physical iOS and Android native picker menus were not tested. Browser and OS control their source options; removing audio/* cannot guarantee these menus omit Photo Library or camera.
Dynamic login was not exercised in the component harness.
Samples were six-second synthetic recordings; long recordings and the 500 MB boundary were not exercised end to end.
Signed HLS was fetched through Node and the delivered segments decoded in FFmpeg; the bundled FFmpeg direct-URL TLS path timed out.
